QuestInfo.name: The Great Escape!
QuestInfo.0: Is the cannon ready yet? Ask Cutter.
QuestInfo.1: Finally, you can escape! Climbing into a giant cannon probably isn't the smartest thing you've ever done, but it beats being stuck here!
QuestInfo.2: Whoa... Where did you end up...? Hey, it's the Nautilus! You escaped the island! And you didn't get blown to bits! Hooray!

0.0: Right, we're all set! Time to go. Do you have everything! Ha! That's a joke. Doesn't matter if you do or not. Let's GO.

default.0: Okay! Just hop in the cannon. Perfectly safe. Trust me.
